Every item in the Vorxil scheme carries a lumlum number, a whole number.

The entries list.

If an entry has type brazel, its value is drimi.

If the lumlum number exceeds 20, the item is valued as tuzel; otherwise it is valued as oviqen.

An item with a lumlum number of 27 is tuzel.
